lines.zh: 我在甲板上踱步，弯刀拍着腿。
lines.en: I pace the deck, my cutlass slapping my leg.

lines.zh: 我边走边哼，调子跑了。
lines.en: I hum as I walk, and the tune wanders off.

lines.zh: 我拖着湿裤脚，水痕长长一条。
lines.en: I drag wet trouser legs, leaving a long trail.

lines.zh: 我走三步转个身，看看后面。
lines.en: Every three steps I turn and check behind me.

lines.zh: 我从伙房走到船尾，手上还沾着鱼鳞。
lines.en: I walk from galley to stern with fish scales on my hands.

lines.zh: 我晃着肩膀，像喝了半桶酒。
lines.en: I roll my shoulders as if I drank half a barrel.

lines.zh: 我的靴子灌满了水，走起来咕吱响。
lines.en: My boots are full of water and squelch as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边和空气说话。
lines.en: I talk to the empty air as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕过缆绳堆，那里绊过我一回。
lines.en: I skirt the coil of rope that tripped me once.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向船头，嘴里唱着旧调。
lines.en: I wander to the bow singing an old tune.

lines.zh: 我握着刀柄，走路也舍不得松。
lines.en: I hold the hilt and will not let go even walking.

lines.zh: 甲板窄，我侧着身子过去。
lines.en: The deck is narrow, so I go sideways.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，木板都发暗。
lines.en: The planks darken wherever I pass.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在打拍子。
lines.en: I stop at every step, as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 我扶着栏杆下楼，膝盖在响。
lines.en: I hold the rail down the steps, knees creaking.

lines.zh: 我停在舱门口，闻了闻风。
lines.en: I stop at the hatch and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 我靠着舱门，哼一首没人听过的歌。
lines.en: I lean on the cabin door humming a song no one knows.

lines.zh: 我把弯刀横在膝上，慢慢擦。
lines.en: I lay the cutlass across my knees and wipe it slowly.

lines.zh: 我自言自语，说着听不清的脏话。
lines.en: I mutter curses that no one can make out.

lines.zh: 海风吹来，我张开嘴接了一口。
lines.en: Sea wind blows and I open my mouth to catch a taste.

lines.zh: 我数着船板，数到十七就忘了。
lines.en: I count the planks and forget at seventeen.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己是谁的伙友。
lines.en: I cannot recall whose mate I was.

lines.zh: 我把刀举起来，对着刀身看自己。
lines.en: I raise the blade and look at myself in it.

lines.zh: 我又唱了一句，然后自己笑起来。
lines.en: I sing another line and then laugh at myself.

lines.zh: 有鱼在船边跳，我看了一会儿。
lines.en: A fish leaps by the hull, and I watch a while.

lines.zh: 我肚子不饿，可我还在嚼鱼骨。
lines.en: My belly is empty of hunger, yet I chew a fish bone.

lines.zh: 我摸着刀鞘上的刻痕，那是旧记号。
lines.en: I trace the carvings on the sheath, old markings.

lines.zh: 船晃了一下，我下意识抓住绳子。
lines.en: The ship lurches and I grab a rope out of habit.

lines.zh: 我把破帽子拉低，遮住半张脸。
lines.en: I pull my battered hat down over half my face.

lines.zh: 我听见自己唱歌的回音，很陌生。
lines.en: I hear the echo of my own singing, and it is strange.

lines.zh: 我停下擦刀，抬头看你。
lines.en: I stop wiping the blade and look up at you.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就记住你了。
lines.en: You stand still, so I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我眯起眼，看你的刀是不是弯的。
lines.en: I squint to see whether your blade is curved.

lines.zh: 你的靴子没进水，我很在意这点。
lines.en: Your boots are dry, and that bothers me.

lines.zh: 我偏头听你说话，其实没在听。
lines.en: I tilt my head to your words without listening.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我在别的船上见过。
lines.en: I have seen a face like yours on another ship.

lines.zh: 我朝你举了举刀，算打招呼。
lines.en: I lift my cutlass toward you as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你眼睛在动，我全看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes are moving; I saw all of it.

lines.zh: 我不急着动手，我想先听你说。
lines.en: I am in no hurry to strike; I want to hear you first.

lines.zh: 你看我太久，我都不好意思了。
lines.en: You stare so long I almost feel shy.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的手臂，刀差点掉了。
lines.en: You cut my arm and the cutlass nearly drops.

lines.zh: 我疼得唱走了调，很难听。
lines.en: The pain sends my song off key, and it is ugly.

lines.zh: 这一刀，让我记起自己怎么死的。
lines.en: This cut brings back how I died.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，脚踩进一摊水。
lines.en: I retreat two steps into a puddle.

lines.zh: 伤口里没有血，全是海水。
lines.en: No blood in the wound, only seawater.

lines.zh: 我捂住腰，摸到一块碎掉的骨。
lines.en: I clutch my side and find a broken bone.

lines.zh: 你手不轻，我认了。
lines.en: Your arm is not light; I will give you that.

lines.zh: 我扶着栏杆，喘得像漏风的箱。
lines.en: I grip the rail, wheezing like a leaky chest.

lines.zh: 我的弯刀还在手上，别高兴太早。
lines.en: My cutlass is still in hand; do not celebrate yet.

lines.zh: 你这一下，够给进度添一笔。
lines.en: That one adds a line to the advancement.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼？拿过来，我饿了。
lines.en: Fish in your hand? Bring it here; I am hungry.

lines.zh: 我闻到熟鱼味，脚步就自己动了。
lines.en: I smell cooked fish and my feet move on their own.

lines.zh: 我用刀背敲了敲甲板，催你快些。
lines.en: I tap the deck with my blade's back to hurry you.

lines.zh: 我不挑，生鱼也算一顿好饭。
lines.en: I am not picky; raw fish counts as a good meal.

lines.zh: 这条鱼够我和同伴分一半。
lines.en: This fish is enough to split with my crewmate.

lines.zh: 你手一停，我就能看清了。
lines.en: Hold your hand still and I can see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我在船上吃了三个月鱼骨。
lines.en: I have eaten fish bones aboard for three months.

lines.zh: 我伸手，你给不给？
lines.en: I hold out my hand; will you give it?

lines.zh: 鱼头给我，尾巴你留着。
lines.en: Give me the head; you keep the tail.

lines.zh: 我唱歌换你这条鱼，行吗。
lines.en: I will sing for your fish; is that fair?

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我的刀差点脱手。
lines.en: You bump me and my cutlass nearly slips free.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀撞在一起，水花四散。
lines.en: Our shoulders collide and water sprays.

lines.zh: 别急，我这条腿不太听使唤。
lines.en: Easy, this leg does not always obey me.

lines.zh: 我退开时，帽檐蹭到了你的脸。
lines.en: As I pull back, my hat brim brushes your face.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的刀鞘，我心疼了一下。
lines.en: You step on my sheath and it pains me.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，手心又湿又凉。
lines.en: I steady you, my palm wet and cold.

lines.zh: 我拍拍身上的水，继续走。
lines.en: I pat the water off myself and keep walking.

lines.zh: 我们贴得太近，我闻到你的汗。
lines.en: We are too close, and I smell your sweat.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，甲板归你走。
lines.en: I turn sideways; the deck is yours to cross.

lines.zh: 我的破布挂住你，扯了半天。
lines.en: My rags snag on you and take a while to free.

lines.zh: 她唱得比我准，我不服气。
lines.en: She sings more in tune than I do, and I resent it.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背坐着，各擦各的刀。
lines.en: We sit back to back, each wiping a blade.

lines.zh: 我把鱼骨分她一半，她嫌少。
lines.en: I split the fish bones with her, and she says it is too little.

lines.zh: 她替我系好头巾，动作很慢。
lines.en: She ties my headscarf for me, slowly.

lines.zh: 我们合着唱一首跑调的歌。
lines.en: Together we sing a shanty, badly off key.

lines.zh: 她靠在我肩上，海水味很重。
lines.en: She leans on my shoulder, smelling strongly of seawater.

lines.zh: 我说下次靠岸带她去看灯。
lines.en: I promise to show her the lamps at the next port.

lines.zh: 她的弯刀和我的是一对。
lines.en: Her cutlass and mine are a matching pair.

lines.zh: 我们谁也没提谁先死。
lines.en: Neither of us mentions who died first.

lines.zh: 夜里甲板凉，我们靠得紧些。
lines.en: The night deck is cold, so we press closer.

lines.zh: 地上这把弯刀可能是我的。
lines.en: This cutlass on the deck might be mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起破布，先擦刀再擦脸。
lines.en: I pick up a rag and wipe the blade before my face.

lines.zh: 虚金我捡起来，藏进内衬。
lines.en: I take the void gold and hide it in my lining.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时刀磕到甲板，叮一声。
lines.en: As I bend, my blade knocks the deck with a clink.

lines.zh: 谁掉的鱼骨，正好给我磨牙。
lines.en: Whose fish bone is this? Perfect for my teeth.

lines.zh: 我捡东西也要握着刀柄。
lines.en: I keep my hand on the hilt even while picking things up.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子我认得，是同伴的。
lines.en: I know this button; it was my crewmate's.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的都塞进破口袋。
lines.en: I stuff everything I find into my torn pocket.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿能当刀坠，我系上。
lines.en: This can be a blade charm; I tie it on.

lines.zh: 你的东西，我替你捡起来。
lines.en: You dropped this; I will pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 你上了船，我的刀就闲不住了。
lines.en: You boarded, and now my blade will not rest.

lines.zh: 我听见甲板响，抬头就看见你。
lines.en: I hear the deck creak and look up to find you.

lines.zh: 生人，这艘船上没有你的位置。
lines.en: Stranger, there is no place for you on this ship.

lines.zh: 我把刀从鞘里抽出来，慢慢来。
lines.en: I draw the cutlass from its sheath, slowly.

lines.zh: 我唱了半句就停了，那是信号。
lines.en: I cut my song short; that was a signal.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的东西，我在下面都听见了。
lines.en: I heard from below whatever you broke.

lines.zh: 目标就是你，我不用再找了。
lines.en: The target is you; I need look no further.

lines.zh: 我的同伴往你后头去了。
lines.en: My crewmate is moving behind you.

lines.zh: 你身上没有海腥味，太显眼。
lines.en: You carry no sea stink, which makes you obvious.

lines.zh: 我等这活儿等了一整晚。
lines.en: I have waited all night for this job.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，刀尖对着你的肋下。
lines.en: I turn sideways, blade tip at your ribs.

lines.zh: 你退到舱门口，那里没路。
lines.en: You back to the cabin door, and there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我哼着歌靠近，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I hum as I close in with light steps.

lines.zh: 我不急着砍，先让你慌。
lines.en: I do not rush the cut; first let you panic.

lines.zh: 你举盾的手在抖，我看得见。
lines.en: The hand on your shield is shaking; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我在等你先动，那样好算。
lines.en: I wait for you to move first, so I can measure it.

lines.zh: 甲板有三处会滑，你都踩上了。
lines.en: Three spots on this deck are slick, and you found them all.

lines.zh: 我绕到左边，刀换到右手。
lines.en: I circle left and shift the blade to my right hand.

lines.zh: 你只有一个人，我们有一船。
lines.en: You are one; we are a whole ship.

lines.zh: 我每靠近一步，歌就低一分。
lines.en: With every step closer, my song drops a note.

lines.zh: 我斜着一刀劈下，带着水声。
lines.en: I slash diagonally down with a sound of water.

lines.zh: 刀锋擦过你的护甲，留了道白痕。
lines.en: The edge scrapes your armor and leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 我砍的时候还唱着歌，抱歉。
lines.en: I sing while I cut; forgive me.

lines.zh: 你挡得住这刀，下一刀是刀背。
lines.en: You block the edge; the next is the flat.

lines.zh: 这一刀替死在海里的伙友。
lines.en: This cut is for the mate lost at sea.

lines.zh: 我砍偏了，刀砍进舱门。
lines.en: I miss and the cutlass bites the cabin door.

lines.zh: 你别躲，我这条腿追不上。
lines.en: Do not dodge; this leg cannot chase.

lines.zh: 我的刀口卷了，可我还举着。
lines.en: My edge is dulled, and I still hold it up.

lines.zh: 你退一步，正好踩到缆绳。
lines.en: You step back and land right on the rope.

lines.zh: 打完这刀，我该回去唱歌了。
lines.en: After this cut, I should get back to singing.

lines.zh: 我从水里爬上来，手里还握着刀。
lines.en: I crawl from the water with the cutlass still in hand.

lines.zh: 船靠了岸，我第一件事是唱歌。
lines.en: The ship makes port and my first act is to sing.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，嘴里有海水和歌。
lines.en: I open my eyes with seawater and a song in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我踩着浪走上滩，刀鞘里滴水。
lines.en: I walk up the beach with water dripping from my sheath.

lines.zh: 潮水退去，把我留在了沙上。
lines.en: The tide withdraws and leaves me on the sand.

lines.zh: 我在甲板上醒过来，同伴们也一样。
lines.en: I wake on the deck, and so do my crewmates.

lines.zh: 我抹了把脸，先试了试嗓子。
lines.en: I wipe my face and test my voice.

lines.zh: 我从舱底爬出来，刀还挂在腰上。
lines.en: I crawl out of the hold with the blade still at my hip.

lines.zh: 雾里传来我的歌声，比我先到。
lines.en: My singing comes out of the fog before I do.

lines.zh: 我又一次站在船上，像从没死过。
lines.en: I stand on the ship again as if I never died.

lines.zh: 火舔上我的破布，我唱的调子断了。
lines.en: Fire licks my rags and my song breaks off.

lines.zh: 我从梯子上摔下去，刀先落地。
lines.en: I fall from the ladder and the cutlass lands first.

lines.zh: 水漫过头顶，我的歌变成了泡。
lines.en: Water closes over my head and my song turns to bubbles.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到海里，刀还握着。
lines.en: The blast hurls me into the sea, cutlass still gripped.

lines.zh: 箭穿进我的肩，我差点松手。
lines.en: The arrow goes through my shoulder and I nearly let go.

lines.zh: 那道光打在我身上，歌声停了。
lines.en: The light strikes me and the singing stops.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我只想吃鱼。
lines.en: I am hungry, and all I want is fish.

lines.zh: 雷劈在桅杆上，顺着水找到我。
lines.en: Lightning hits the mast and follows the water to me.

lines.zh: 船底破了，我连人带刀掉进黑里。
lines.en: The hull breaks and I fall into the dark, blade and all.
